notes.title: One Year in Early Access
notes.content:
After more than one hundred patches, several thousands of bug fixes, tweaks and adjustments it is time to conclude Dreadful Rivers first year of being in Early Access.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=bBHbkOh01zM
 
Since the first release in February 28, 2023 a bunch of new content has found its way into the game:


way, WAY better performance
and still better graphics
the SEARCH FOR THE CROWNSTONES mainquest branch is fully implemented
a gateway town  where the river branches into the three biomes was introduced
there are now forts to conquer
and more factions
there’s wildlife, hunting and fishing
on land ruins, mines, caves, and ancient starling halls are waiting to be explored
skill trees, including special crown skills
more character classes for hire
siege engines
crew members can be positioned on the raft
nicer to use inventory system
more stuff to collect, use, craft and cook
loads of general QoL and bugfixes
Achievements


Now what’s next?


the underworld biome
more gear, spells, weapons
additional crafting plans and cooking recipes
new skilltrees
various new enemy types
new siege engine types
new factions
more dungeons
overall more river

For the future we are also experimenting with different game ideas in the background to follow up the development of Dreadful River. One of them is THEY CAME FROM VENUS, another one was in cryostasis for some years now and will be revealed in some weeks time.

Ending our update post with an obligatory busy-working-on-stuff picture.

https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/3357962/302faa2a0e5a2f16e281252215556596f560fed2.jpg

See you next time  :)

notes.title: Three Months
notes.content:
A new month arrived and it's time for the latest updates. 

Steam has reviewed Dreadful River for Steamdeck and it is playable with restrictions. We are aiming for full support in the future.

Also, we are now able to publish Steam Trading Cards for Dreadful River, which we will be addressing soon.

Last month we focused especially on already implemented game elements to further improve them and fix bugs. 

This way new dungeons, loot, usability and performance improvements found their way into the current version.


The next features are

 first skills
 capturable fortresses
 and a new enemy faction



You missed the last patch notes? Here you have the complete list of changes.

Thank you for your valuable feedback and until the next update.

notes.title: Two Months
notes.content:
Two months have passed since the Early Access release. We are happy that you continue to explore the river and its surroundings and give us your feedback! Many new features have been added recently:


 You can now ride elevators to explore the dungeons in the Starling Ruins.
 On the raft, you can position crew members to better use their various combat skills.
 The inventory now has tabs.
 Healing potions can be activated directly from the inventory.
 Stamina and mana are displayed.
 You can hire priests to heal your crew.
 Another new class is the Berserker, which can fight with two weapons.
 On land you can now sprint.



Here you can see the latest updates:
Latest changes

Feedback and bug reports will be answered and processed as soon as possible. Keep it up!

The next major updates


 New enemy types
 Custom siege weapons
 More dungeons, cities and environments

... and soon even more. Keep letting us know your ideas and suggestions!
